label: Quest

intro: Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp calls upon Horde allies to hunt the Skullsplitter tribe living to the southeast. Although the Darkspears left Stranglethorn Vale behind, their ancient conflict with these jungle rivals remains unresolved. Returning with twenty-five split bone trophies aids the Darkspears in their war and earns their friendship.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you have gathered Bloodscalp trophies, I have another task for you. The Skullsplitter tribe of trolls live to the southeast, and for years we have warred with them. Although the Darkspears no longer dwell in Stranglethorn, we are bound to our conflict with the Skullsplitters.
So, hunt them. Gather their Split Bone Necklaces and return to me. Aid us in our war, and you will earn the friendship of the Darkspears.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Skullsplitters will curse the day they brought us to war! Is your task complete?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your strength is great to have gained these necklaces, friend. The Skullsplitters fall to you like young saplings stomped to earth by a Basilisk!
Your deeds are a boon to us.
